mission: Personal State Engine Gate F formal sealed-final evaluation

baseline.purpose: frozen retrieval-backend comparison; not a tuning target

infrastructure_retry_allowed_only_if: no case-level prediction or metric was produced
failure occurred before sealed-final selection output was observed
retry rationale and environment delta are recorded before retry
sealed_final_policy.exposure_rule: No sealed-final listing, path resolution, fetch, read, hash, or execution occurs before this protocol commit exists. After freeze, access is limited to the minimum surfaces required for the single formal execution.

implementation_lock_policy.if_schema_adapter_is_required: Adapter may be implemented only from schema/format information before any labels, answers, rankings, predictions, aggregate metrics, or selection-bearing outputs are observed; adapter must be tested on synthetic fixtures and committed before formal evaluation. No selection thresholds may change.

schema_contingencies.if_no_no_evidence_cases_exist: No-evidence metrics are reported NOT_APPLICABLE and are not treated as failures; all answerable, integrity, and paired noninferiority criteria remain mandatory.
schema_contingencies.if_case_type_labels_are_absent: Do not infer labels from model outputs. Use only benchmark-ground-truth answerability fields already encoded in the official schema; if answerability cannot be deterministically resolved without inspecting semantic answer content, stop with GATE_F_SCHEMA_NOT_EVALUABLE_UNDER_PREREGISTRATION.

all_required: sealed-final benchmark byte identity recorded after authorized opening and not modified

allowed_on_pass: Candidate-v6 passed Gate F on the preregistered sealed-final benchmark
